kind_note: Two score phases over 2026-10-07-tlsf-rerun's 3000 run directories: maximality (curves with ideals, and the .members.tsv sidecars), then the separation recount at fingerprint seed 0 over those sidecars. No search, no decision rule.

maximality_pass.output: experiments/curves-tlsf-rerun.csv (728,737 rows) and curves-tlsf-rerun/<host>/ with one <run>.csv and <run>.members.tsv per run
maximality_pass.against_archive: The paper-rerun-curves maximality pass took 183.9 worker-hours on av2 for 15 seeds, with 57 runs at the 7500 s deadline. This pass took 63.05 worker-hours for 30 seeds with none at the deadline.
maximality_pass.warnings: 70 a phase, one for each censored run directory: run.json unreadable, the run having been killed at the 7200 s search cap. Expected; the scorer reads such a run from its accumulator.

recount_pass.against_archive: The archived recount took about 20 core-hours over two hosts.

results.note: Mean per run at the 7200 s cut over all 750 runs an arm, a run without the metric counting zero, from analysis-output.txt. analyse_matched.py in the search archive averages the maximal metrics over runs that found a repair, so its aurus-arm values are higher.

deviations.dequeue_16_57: The queued scoring entries on all three hosts (av2 049, av3 046, av1 012) were cancelled at about 16:57 on 2026-10-08 with the search entries ahead of them, and re-enqueued after 2026-10-08-fretish-rerun-analysis. None had started, so no scoring work was lost.
deviations.accumulator_double_count: The search's 16:57 dequeue left 63 run directories whose accumulated/index.tsv holds two attempts, and score_curves.read_index counts both. The solutions curve over-counts by 9.23 a run on weighted/mrs at 7200 s, 5.34 on weighted/aurus, 1.10 on nsga2-apportion/mrs and 0.42 on nsga2-apportion/aurus; ideal_solutions by 0.021 to 0.053. The maximal and epsilon metrics read each file once and no members.tsv repeats a file, but 13 of the 63 runs diverged from their killed attempt and its 1044 orphaned files can sit in their antichains. Measured and recorded in the search archive's analysis-output.txt; unresolved here.
deviations.av2_first_manifest_overwritten: Entry 052 rewrote the score manifest that entry 047 left for seeds 0-12. The binary commit for those 1300 runs rests on the queue log (047 staged 48856b7) and on 48856b7 being engine-identical to df219b9.
deviations.early_entries_failed: Before the search had run, av3 043 failed for want of a results directory and av1 009 failed too; both were cancelled, as were av3 044 and av1 010, and scoring was re-queued behind the search.

added.analyse_scoring.py: Written for this close: per phase and host, the timings ledger, warnings by kind and the per-arm means at the 7200 s cut.

owed: Re-score the 63 two-attempt run directories with each index cut to its last attempt, or accept the measured over-count.
The pooled strength pass (PLAN.md, Afterwards), as its own campaign over the collected sidecars.

files.campaign.toml: The two score phases the hosts read.
files.scripts/: Four scripts vendored at df219b9, and analyse_scoring.py.
files.score-manifests/: The final score manifest of each phase on each host.
files.curves-tlsf-rerun.csv, curves-tlsf-rerun: The collected outputs. Untracked, in experiments/ of the collecting checkout.

reproduce: Check out df219b9, build the release preset with the search's results-tlsf-rerun/ in place, and run campaign.toml's two phases through campaign.py on the search's host split. To re-derive the figures, run analyse_scoring.py with the collected outputs in experiments/.
